semantic_facts.value: The company is engaged in the business of Sewerage contractors, Sewerage tretament plants, transmission & Distribution & building and maintainance of own items which are used for construction purpose. Based on sinilarity of activities, risk and reward structure, organisation structure and internal reporting system, the company has structured its operations into single operating segment and hence there is no reportable segment as per IND AS 108 Operating Segment .
Generation of power through renewable sources and related services
The Company is engaged in the business relating to products, projects and systems for electricity transmission and related activities only. Accordingly, the Company has only one operating segment.
